description: This file provides utility functions for working with MLIR values within TensorFlow's DTensor module, including shape extraction, constant creation, and type/value analysis.

methods.name: ValueRank
methods.description: Returns the rank (dimension count) of the given MLIR value.

methods.name: EffectivelyScalarR1Type
methods.description: Creates a rank-1 tensor type representing an effective scalar of the given element type.

methods.name: ReshapeSizeTypeToScalar
methods.description: Reshapes a size tensor of type tensor<i32> to a scalar value.

methods.name: GetTFShapeFromType
methods.description: Retrieves the shape as an integer vector from an MLIR type, handling resource types.

methods.name: IntConst
methods.description: Creates a 1D int32 constant MLIR value from given values.

methods.name: Int64Const
methods.description: Creates a 1D int64 constant MLIR value from given values.

methods.name: FloatConst
methods.description: Creates a 1D float32 constant MLIR value from given values.

methods.name: StringConst
methods.description: Creates a tf.string constant array MLIR value from given string values.

methods.name: StringScalarConst
methods.description: Creates a tf.string scalar constant MLIR value from a single string.

methods.name: IntConstWithMatchingType
methods.description: Creates a constant with the specified type matching the provided type.

methods.name: ExtractConstIntFromValue
methods.description: Extracts a constant int64 value from an MLIR value.

methods.name: ExtractConstVectorFromValue
methods.description: Extracts a vector of int64 constants from an MLIR value.

methods.name: CreateIntScalarConst
methods.description: Creates an int scalar constant MLIR value with the specified value.

methods.name: CreateZeroScalarConst
methods.description: Creates a scalar zero constant of the specified type.

methods.name: SelectScalarValueFromArray
methods.description: Selects a scalar value from a 1D array MLIR value at a specified index.

methods.name: GetSubtypeOrSelf
methods.description: Returns the subtype of a value if it has one, otherwise returns the type itself.

methods.name: IsResourceType
methods.description: Checks if the MLIR value has a resource type.
